name: Web Hero Split
description: A two-part hero: supporting image on one side, a proposition and a primary action on the other. The eye lands on the image, crosses to the headline and settles on the call to action.
spacing: A clear column gap between the image half and the text half, with the headline, body and action set as one left-aligned group inside the safe area below the navigation band.
responsive_behavior: Below a tablet width the halves stack: image first, then the text group. The action never drops below the fold on a common laptop viewport.
